description: Phase FRP-7 V1.5 supplement §22.1 rotation metric. Asserts at least one selector-driven rotation occurs in the 7-day window AND the recipient sees a plain-language Explanation AND end-to-end recovery wall-clock ≤ 60 s. Drives a synthetic public_ip:* cooldown on day 3, asserts the recommender returns L3 high confidence (per supplement §14.1), asserts the executor performs the floating-IP swap, asserts the recipient's RouteHealthBanner re-attaches inside the budget. The Explanation produced on the recipient side carries reason='Used X because tcp_reset on previous IP', not an identifier.
